goals: Handle a short Russian exchange about school and studies.

examples.en: I'm going to revise tonight.
She's going to miss the lecture.
Are you going to finish the homework?

dialogue.en: Have you got an exam tomorrow?

dialogue.t: Да, история. После пары буду повторять.
dialogue.r: da, istoriya. posle pary budu povtoryat'.
dialogue.en: Yes, history. I'll revise after class.
Shall we study in the library?
Yes. The notes deadline is today.

grammar.title: нужно / должен

examples.en: You have to show your passport.

grammar.title: если + наст., то будущее

examples.t: Если пойдёт дождь, мы отменим пикник.
examples.r: yesli poydyot dozhd', my otmenim piknik
examples.en: If it rains, we'll cancel the picnic.
If the forecast is good, we'll walk.
If it doesn't clear up, we'll stay inside.

mistakes: В если не ставьте чистое будущее без нужды.

dialogue.en: The forecast says showers.
If it rains, we'll go to the museum.
Take an umbrella anyway.
If it clears up, we'll walk by the river.

grammar.title: обычно + наст. vs собираться

examples.en: I usually leave at seven.
I'm going to save next month.
My shift starts at nine.

mistakes: Не используйте собираться для печатного расписания.

dialogue.en: What time do you usually start?

dialogue.t: Смена в девять. В следующем месяце поменяю.
dialogue.r: smena v devyat'. v sleduyushchem mesyatse pomenyayu.
dialogue.en: The shift starts at nine. I'm going to change it next month.
Why?
I want a shorter commute. That's the goal.
